name: M3 short heat-set insert (CNC Kitchen M3 x 3)
summary: Brass insert melted into a printed part. Needs a 4 mm hole at least 4 mm deep.
source: CNC Kitchen metric insert table: M3 x 3 is 3 mm long and 4.6 mm across the knurl, wants a 4 mm hole at least 4 mm deep and at least 1.6 mm of plastic around the hole. The short version is for thin walls and lids. Other brands of the same nominal size differ by a few tenths, so test-fit one before printing a whole enclosure.
